scripts.build:sites: pnpm build:design-system && pnpm --filter @harnessa/marketing build && pnpm --filter @harnessa/cloud-portal build
scripts.deploy:marketing: pnpm build:marketing && wrangler pages deploy apps/marketing/dist --project-name=harnessa-site --branch=main
scripts.deploy:cloud-portal: pnpm build:cloud-portal && wrangler pages deploy apps/cloud-portal/build --project-name=harnessa-cloud --branch=main
scripts.typecheck:api: uv run mypy --follow-imports=silent apps/api/harnessa/contracts.py apps/api/harnessa/services apps/api/harnessa/domain apps/api/harnessa/adapters apps/api/harnessa/db/orchestration.py apps/api/harnessa/db/model_gateway.py apps/api/harnessa/db/models.py apps/api/harnessa/db/session.py apps/api/harnessa/api/task_routes.py apps/api/harnessa/api/model_routes.py apps/api/harnessa/healthcheck.py apps/api/harnessa/worker.py
scripts.lint:api: uv run ruff check apps/api tests
